tableLines.line: SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Nina speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

The little star inside Brian goes quiet — and wakes up inside Priya. Brian never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Priya will never be hungry again while it hums, and Brian is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.
